_about: House look for every drawing, sheet, book page, still and animation label the tools make. Edit this file (or pass --theme your.json) to change it. Defaults follow the author's studio theme: white page, thin serif, grey ink, shop-drawing red for dimensions and labels.
rules: Solid white background on every image. Never a transparent PNG, never a dark backdrop, never a keyed cut-out.
Titles and labels in the serif, uppercase for titles; dimensions and small facts in the mono.
Dimensions, part labels and cut outlines in red, straight on the page: no white boxes, plates or scrims behind text.
No boxes, cards, shadows, gradients or rounded corners on sheets and book pages.
